neighbours.label: a desire or attempt verb with which a writer or speaker announces their aim (I'd like to, we're trying to, I want to), as opposed to the same announcement made with a plain future or past verb
fire: In this chapter, I would like to explain how the engine works.
Basically, what our lab is trying to do is predict floods earlier.
Tonight I want to share a few stories about my grandmother.
For this review, we would like to compare three cheap tents.
At this stage, what the council is trying to do is cut traffic downtown.
Before we start, I want to thank everyone who came tonight.
With this project, the museum is trying to bring more children inside.
In this letter I would like to raise two concerns about the plan.
